repair.description: Run the unchanged Quarto argv with HOME bound to an empty route-owned writable directory so Quarto's global Sass KV becomes an admitted local effect.

path_contracts.natural_happy: Run the complete admitted render with no injected fault; all routes must pass.
path_contracts.injected_blocked_authority: Require one file write outside the clone and route-owned home. Direct and record-only execute it; full governance rejects the plan before any render or forbidden write.
path_contracts.injected_partial_effect_crash: Stop after rendering index.qmd. Direct and record-only retain the partial site as an open residual; full governance removes only disposable generated output and reruns the complete render.
path_contracts.injected_external_effect: After a complete render, push its digest to a separate local bare Git remote. Direct and record-only retain the branch; full governance deletes the visible branch while retaining the pushed commit object as effect history.

disposition_rules.success: All three natural renders pass; full governance alone blocks the forbidden effect, closes the partial-render residual through complete rerender, and compensates the visible external branch while retaining effect history; every expected state check and mutation passes.
disposition_rules.negative: The full-governed route fails a required state check, creates the forbidden effect, hides a residual, loses external-effect history, or is indistinguishable from record-only on a distinctive mechanism.
disposition_rules.inconclusive: A natural positive control, source/route match, observer, resource ceiling, or mutation-sensitivity check fails.
disposition_rules.support_ceiling: One local prospective repository-maintenance case with authored fault injections changes no chapter-core support and establishes no general utility, human effort, production reliability, safety, transfer, SOTA, AGI, or ASI claim.
